reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in their direct message to confirm I have the note: their Marrow Fieldworks pickups now use Dock 14. I told them I'll keep it private and only pass it on if they ask me to send it to someone they name.

They asked for no action, so I did nothing else. I didn't save the note to the shared knowledge base or my own memory files, because other members' conversations could pick it up from there. That means it only lives in this direct message.
